title: Universal Direct Update Legacy Handoff and Host-Managed ACL Compatibility
summary: Removes host-managed ACL and ownership layout as a blocker for direct legacy-to-current updates, while preserving strict world-write, special-bit, symlink, path-type and source-identity safety.
changelog: Allows authentic legacy releases to hand off directly to the current target when the installation uses host-managed group, named or default ACLs.
Replaces ownership changes and whole-mode normalization with bounded symbolic owner-right repair on the exact privileged chain.
Preserves safe group-managed mode and ACL authority while continuing to reject other/world write and special bits.
Keeps symlink, wrong path type, world-writable runtime authority and tampered pre-overlay identity checks fail-closed.
Covers the real v0.7.18-to-current post-overlay handoff with the actual target permission gate, bridge and schema request.
Does not change update topology, database schema, frontend, rollback architecture or the separate Stage 6.6.1 boundary.
